tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: Parametric 3D-printable part templates with their parameter JSON schema (hose adapters, end caps, spacers, clips, brackets, boxes, furniture feet). Detailimallid ja nende parameetrite skeem: vali sobiv mall ja mõõdud skeemi järgi.

tools.name: list_materials
tools.description: Available print materials (type and colour) with the code to use in quotes and whether it is in stock. Materjalid: tüüp, värv, kood hinnapäringuks ja kas on laos.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search ready-made catalog products by keywords (Estonian synonyms understood). Empty query lists all. Otsi valmis tooteid kataloogist märksõnade järgi.

tools.name: quote_template
tools.description: Price, size and delivery date for a template part with the given parameters (same calculation as the website configurator; takes up to a minute). Returns order_url: the customer orders and pays there. Hind, mõõdud ja tarneaeg; tellimine käib lingi kaudu veebis.

tools.name: quote_product
tools.description: Price and delivery date for a catalog product (sku from search_catalog). The customer orders on the product page. Kataloogitoote hind ja tarneaeg; tellimine tootelehel.

tools.name: track_order
tools.description: Status and expected delivery of an order or a purchase (several items paid together), by the link from the confirmation email (…/ost/12?k=… or …/tellimus/123?k=…). Tellimuse või ostu seis ja eeldatav tarne kirjas oleva lingi järgi.

tools.name: create_upload_url
tools.description: One-time URL (15 min) to upload the customer's own 3D file (.stl, .3mf, .step) with HTTP PUT, raw file as body; then call quote_upload. Ühekordne link kliendi 3D-faili üleslaadimiseks (PUT), siis quote_upload.

tools.name: quote_upload
tools.description: Price, size and delivery for an uploaded file (upload_id from the PUT response; black PETG, 1 piece). The customer pays at checkout; the shop reviews every customer file before printing and refunds if it cannot be printed. Hind üles laaditud failile; klient maksab kohe, operaator vaatab faili üle en
